_comment: MS1.1 required-component inventory (plan rev 6-9, macOS plan:396-401; RoseCat 5968/5974/5995/6002).
MS1 ships ONLY the browser (build.zig:168 installs zigBrowser; the agent runtime is a separate
non-default step), so the MS1 inventory is the browser alone and resources is empty. 'complete'
means every native Mach-O the bundle actually ships. The census (tests/e2e/mac_universal_test.py)
scans the whole bundle for every Mach-O and requires each fat (x86_64 + arm64) and every role
present at its exact path_glob; the fail-closed probe rejects any file `file` cannot classify.
The empty 'resources' list is accepted by the typed phase gate (mac_resource_compat.py
--milestone MS1) ONLY for this exact browser-only shape; see resource_phase. The agent-runtime
roles (python-runtime, claude-cli as fat Mach-O; the generated zb-claude launcher + runtime files
as byte-compat resources) are added to THIS inventory in MS5's red, where macOS provisioning
first installs them and the two-tree resource_compat oracle runs on the per-arch trees (MS5.1c).
